text.aria-label: Title text 'Figure 15: Describing each plant to a shared XGBoost model lowers error, less so for an unseen plant'
text.tspan: Figure 15: Describing each plant to a shared XGBoost model lowers error,
less so for an unseen plant

text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Change in error of a shared XGBoost model given plant information, compared with the same model given none (G-B0), in percentage points of capacity; more negative is better. Dot: estimate. Line: 95% interval from resampling whole months. Each row label gives the two models' mean absolute errors (% of capacity). Orange: the scored plant was in training. Purple: the scored plant was left out of training, an unseen plant. A post hoc decomposition in the follow-up report attributes the gain to the transfer ratio and finds the clipping ceiling does not help an unseen plant.'
text.tspan: Change in error of a shared XGBoost model given plant information, compared with the same model given none (G-B0),
in percentage points of capacity; more negative is better. Dot: estimate. Line: 95% interval from resampling whole
Each row label gives the two models' mean absolute errors (% of capacity). Orange: the scored plant was in
training. Purple: the scored plant was left out of training, an unseen plant.
A post hoc decomposition in the follow-up report attributes the gain to the transfer ratio and finds the clipping
ceiling does not help an unseen plant.

text.aria-label: Title text 'The fingerprint (G-FP) describes each plant by its transfer ratio (TF), clipping ceiling (CK), and daily shape. Lead-day 1 is the forecast for the day after the day it is issued. All rows are exploratory. Arms. G-B0: one global XGBoost model with no plant information. G-ID: one global model given a plant code. G-L1: one global model given L1. G-FP: one global model given the plant's TF, CK, and daily shape (a fingerprint). LOPO: leave one plant out, meaning the scored plant is left out of training. TF: the 30-day ratio of power to forecast irradiance (the transfer ratio). CK: the plant's clipping ceiling.'
text.tspan: The fingerprint (G-FP) describes each plant by its transfer ratio (TF), clipping ceiling (CK), and daily shape. Lead-day 1 is
the forecast for the day after the day it is issued.
Arms. G-B0: one global XGBoost model with no plant information. G-ID: one global model given a plant code. G-L1: one global
model given L1. G-FP: one global model given the plant's TF, CK, and daily shape (a fingerprint). LOPO: leave one plant out,
meaning the scored plant is left out of training. TF: the 30-day ratio of power to forecast irradiance (the transfer ratio).
